description: DataSourceBrowser owns generic normalization and parameters; Ingestion consumes opaque folder IDs, not path joins. Tests first: empty-map normalization property, root/child/up and destinations, Skills picker and Ingestion LiveView regression. Real scopes where practical, external listings controlled. Preserve Disk paths. Docs: shared browser contract.
